about: Look invariants: one entry per flaw the owner reported, each a view (q, a still: speed=0 is added) with absolute measures and limits (tools/lib/measures.mjs). Fields: reported (the date), wrong (what was wrong, in one line), measures (each: measure, region [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the picture, its options, and min and/or max), bad and fixed (commits where it was bad and where it was fixed: the proof), expected ('fail': a known open flaw; it is reported as KNOWN, and passing fails the run so that the mark is removed), reference (values measured on other commits, for reading only). The stills are of size (unless --size; the limits hold at this size). A limit changes only on purpose, in a commit that says why.
